//: Type-checks the COMMITTED generated components, plus the hand-written render
tests that exercise them. Emits nothing — it exists only to prove the
compiler's output is valid, runnable code.
Run via `pnpm typecheck:examples`. Before this existed, examplesUpToDate.test.ts
only proved the output text had not changed, never that it compiled or worked.
moduleResolution is 'Bundler', not the repo-wide 'NodeNext': the emitted
components use extensionless relative imports (`from "./Dialog"`) because they
are consumed by a bundler, not by Node's ESM loader. Checking them under
NodeNext would fail them for a convention correct for their actual target.
